newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil announces new rules for pension funds.
newsitem.headline: Brazil announces new rules for pension funds.

text.p: Brazil's National Monetary Council has approved new rules for pension fund investments which seek to reduce their risk exposure, a statement said.
Among the measures are a new ceiling, equivalent to 10 percent of each fund's total portfolio, on investments in real estate. Currently the limit is 20 percent, the statement said.
Investments in any one company may not exceed 20 percent of a total portfolio, down from a current 25 percent, and all stock holdings must be in publicly traded companies.
Other new rules included lower limits on loans to real estate development and to fund participants and controls on derivative investments.
